status: Installed and verified: persistent, reversible web-only fixes for the GT-BE19000AI AiMesh node
changes: Restore the native AI Board / Docker menu after mode-specific navigation filtering.
Fix light/dark logo selection, standalone/embedded UI4 theme inheritance and text contrast.
Load jQuery UI before the legacy RequireJS loader to avoid anonymous AMD conflicts.
On AiMesh nodes, replace the empty local SDN profile editor with actual wireless status and a controller settings link.
Read CPU/RAM from the existing local telemetry endpoint; derive CPU percentage from counter deltas.
Count locally authorized wireless clients per band instead of LAN-discovered devices.
Show AI board IP and container status; prefer the validated IPv4 address for existing app links.
Match the existing legacy re_mode=1 policy-popup exemption in the new wrapper. Consent records and feature-specific EULA flows remain unchanged.
Explicitly label unavailable Wi-Fi history; avoid the absent raw-history endpoint without substituting incompatible sampled data.
Override the hardcoded translucent-white AI app cards in dark mode; keep disabled controls disabled while improving text and button contrast.

verification.chrome: Dashboard, Network wireless status, Tools system information and AI Board pages inspected in native Chrome.

containers_observed: slm-asus — Up 14 minutes (after AI board firmware update)
ai_page.portainer: Not installed; native install control visible
ai_page.home_assistant: Not installed; native install control visible
ai_page.frigate: Not installed; native install control visible

verification.policy_popup: No automatic ASUS base-policy popup after reload and a fresh authenticated login on this node.
verification.deployment: All nine mounted files verified by SHA256; repeated apply tested without stacking bind mounts.

persistence.guard: Skip if model or role does not match, disabled marker exists, or current firmware web-file hashes differ.

ai_update_observed.initiator: Not established; user confirmation requested. No update command intentionally issued by this web-overlay deployment.

limitations: This is a first set of concrete web UI repairs, not an exhaustive audit of every page.
Stock httpd still lacks the Wi-Fi raw-history API; history is unavailable.
Portainer, Home Assistant and Frigate have only been exposed; their installation and functional tests have not been performed.
No AI-specific terms were accepted, no AI query was submitted, and no WAN management was enabled.
Persistence was verified by the startup hook, mounted file hashes and idempotent apply, without rebooting the router.
AiMesh Wi-Fi configuration still belongs to the controller; this change does not resolve the separate WPA3 profile synchronization or LAN-bond reboot issues.

manifest.scope: Authenticated local node web UI; no network-role or authentication changes
